242	And who could defeat him if not Moshe Rabbeinu?	E quem poderia vencê-lo, se não Moshe Rabeinu?
243	Moshe was a giant too.	Moshe também era um gigante.

246	He killed him.	Ele o matou.

248	Og didn't need an army at all.	Og não precisava de exército nenhum.
249	He would do like this to the people who came to fight him.	Ele fazia assim com quem vinha lutar contra ele.

253	All that he did to the Amorite, meaning Og king of Bashan and Sichon king of the Amorites, that is what he did to them.	Tudo o que fez ao amorreu, isto é, a Og, rei de Bashan, e a Sichon, rei dos amorreus, isso foi o que fez a eles.
254	"And Moav was terrified" — they were afraid. Look what these people did! What did they do?	"E Moav teve pavor" — tiveram medo. Vejam o que esses fizeram! O que fizeram?

258	Og — we were relying on Og. Og was our ally.	Og — contávamos com Og. Og era nosso aliado.
